title: Thanksgiving In Minecraft
description: Set the Thanksgiving Dinner Table for all of your friends! A fun challenge with rewards waiting for you!
body:
**Set the Table! Here Comes the Feast Minecraft Has Been Waiting For!**

---

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/mrBZKhHCFFA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

This data pack introduces a new fun mechanic! Build a table out of any wooden stairs and slabs, 7 long and 3 wide, with upside-down stairs at the ends that face inwards. When you place an item frame in the center facing down, and place a Turkey (cooked chicken) in the center, you will create a Thanksgiving Dinner Table! From here, you must supply the table with cooked mutton, cooked salmon, bread, carrots, baked potatoes, pumpkin pie, rabbit stew, milk, and a water bottle to get the feast going! After all of that, you will be rewarded for your efforts!

To lock the table with whatever contents it currently has, just break the item frame. If you want to remove a table, break the slab that the item frame is/was on. Please be careful with your table! I am not responsible for any lost items from destroying the table. Whatever you place, you will not receive it back!

This table can also be used as a fun decoration!

**This data pack works great in Java 1.21.3 vanilla, as an additional Survival mode goal!**
